title: No, just no
text:
No, just no. I used these with the Fizzini by Hamilton Beach and they were always forcing water back through the tube. It ended up rusting the nozzle in the Fizzini. I went through 2 of them due to this and wasn't about to risk drinking rust.
The fizzini comes with 10 cartridges so I can vouch for the difference between the two.

Proceed with caution as I now have about 40 unused CO2 cartridges and I need to find out how to properly dispose of them.
